page_title: AST 1-1 IPS | Aston Villa v Ipswich 15/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Here comes a substitution. Omari Hutchinson is given a rest as he is replaced by Jack Taylor (Ipswich).
90+5' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) picks up a caution.
90+4' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

90+4' The ball is out of play and Aston Villa manage to earn a corner. Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
90+2' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

90+2' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Aston Villa. Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
90+1' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
88' Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) is caught offside!
87' Aston Villa fail to score from a corner as Alex Palmer (Ipswich) leaps to collect the ball.
84' What a big chance! Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
83' A quickly taken corner by Aston Villa.

82' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball goes out of play. Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
82' Aston Villa take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
82' Aston Villa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
80' Kieran McKenna has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Massimo Luongo (Ipswich) replacing Jens Cajuste.
80' Substitution. George Hirst (Ipswich) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Liam Delap walks off.
79' The resulting set piece from Aston Villa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

78' The ball is laid off to Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom left corner and forces Alex Palmer to make a decent save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Aston Villa.
77' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
74' Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Aston Villa.

72' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by Alex Palmer, who pulls off a stunning save! Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
72' Aston Villa take a short corner kick.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Aston Villa comes to nothing.
69' 1 - 1 Goal! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 1:1.
69' What a strike! Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) hits the left post from the free kick.
68' Today's referee Robert Jones rightly decides to book Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) for his harsh tackle.
67' Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
63' Donyell Malen goes off the pitch and Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) comes on.
63' The free kick from close range, taken by Aston Villa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
63' Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Robert Jones signals. Aston Villa have been awarded a free kick.
59' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

58' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the roof of the net, but Alex Palmer is equal to it and makes an easy save. Aston Villa force a corner. They send men into the box.
56' 0 - 1 Goal! Liam Delap (Ipswich) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Omari Hutchinson, then sends the ball inside the left post. 0:1.
54' Jacob Greaves (Ipswich) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
52' Ipswich have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

51' What an opportunity! Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the right post!

50' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) connects with a cross on the edge of the box, controls the ball and pulls the trigger. Alex Palmer makes a beautiful save to deny his effort which would have ended inside the right post.
46' Unai Emery makes a half-time substitution. Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) comes on in place of Lucas Digne.
46' Unai Emery has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) comes on the pitch for Jacob Ramsey.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Jack Clarke comes off for Luke Woolfenden (Ipswich).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+2' The corner is swung in but Aston Villa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Aston Villa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
44' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar.
44' Tyrone Mings (Aston Villa) glances on a header from the corner sent into the near post, but his close-range effort is blocked by a defender.
44' Aston Villa earn a corner.
43' John McGinn (Aston Villa) takes just a short run up and his weak free kick from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
40' Robert Jones blows his whistle and Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
39' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
36' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
35' Wow, what an escape. Liam Delap (Ipswich) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
32' Rough tackle by John McGinn (Aston Villa). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) sees a yellow card from Robert Jones after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
26' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
25' Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but Emiliano Martinez dives superbly to deny him. His shot went towards the right side of the goal.
24' John McGinn (Aston Villa) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Ipswich.
23' John McGinn (Aston Villa) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. A free kick to Ipswich.
20' 0:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
17' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) is being substituted because of an injury. Kieran McKenna sends Jack Clarke on the pitch.
16' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) is substituted due to injury. Unai Emery gives a chance to Tyrone Mings.
16' Aston Villa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

15' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Good work from Aston Villa as they win a corner.
13' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went to the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez made an easy save.
9' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
7' Liam Delap (Ipswich) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
6' Great teamplay by Aston Villa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' Flag goes up against Liam Delap (Ipswich) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Ipswich will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Robert Jones.
